prose: The Wall Street Journal reports, citing OpenRouter data, that business spending was split roughly evenly between OpenAI and Anthropic models in September, against a 75% Anthropic share in January. The piece frames it as a heating price war and notes both companies need to show sustainable businesses ahead of planned IPOs.
The article is paywalled, so only the excerpt was available.
highlights: OpenAI and Anthropic about even in September business spend
Anthropic had 75% in January, per OpenRouter
Price war cited as the driver
